_meta.purpose: Daily Undulating Periodization session-type patterns for 3- and 4-day-per-week training.

name: Daily Undulating Periodization
description: Within-week variation of rep ranges and intensity. Same rotation repeats every week. Prevents accommodation, supports concurrent strength and hypertrophy goals.

strength.label: Strength
strength.notes: Heavy compound work. Build maximal force production.

hypertrophy.label: Hypertrophy
hypertrophy.notes: Moderate load, higher reps. Metabolic stress and muscle growth emphasis.

power.label: Power/Speed
power.notes: Light-to-moderate load. Bar speed is the priority, not load.
